remarks: Dive right in just in time for summer! Nestled within Stamford's most classic and sought after mid-city, park-like community, The Chesterfield II, built in 2000, has unmatched amenities including an abundance of walking paths and greenspace, gated entry, ample guest parking, two swimming pools and a clubhouse. This end unit with an open layout and high ceilings is conveniently located on the first level. The modern kitchen with breakfast bar and newer Samsung stainless steel appliances overlooks the dining area and living room. The spacious bedroom with multiple natural light exposures has a walk-in closet, access to the bathroom and sliders to an outdoor, pebbled sitting area (unique feature!) - enjoy your morning paper and coffee or afternoon tea in the fresh air! Central air, in-unit washer & dryer, on-site dedicated storage, freshly painted throughout and the most ideally located reserved garage parking space completes this mid-city jewel. Directly across the street and/or down the block from shopping, restaurants and conveniences (Starbucks, Whole Foods, etc.) and only moments to Stamford's vibrant downtown entertainment district, Metro North RR and I-95, this is a great opportunity to be in the center of it all, yet privately tucked away! Come experience luxury community living in Connecticut today!
